name: Air Filters
description: Pre-filters, fine/medium filters, HEPA systems, and carbon filtration designed for medical, commercial, and industrial HVAC applications.

name: Dampers
description: UL-classified fire dampers, smoke dampers, dynamic curtain dampers, and volume control dampers for active building protection and air control.

name: Sound Attenuators
description: Acoustic silencers (rectangular, tubular, crosstalk, bend) with high insertion loss ratings tested under ASTM standards to reduce HVAC noise.

name: Coatings Adhesives & Sealants
description: UL-listed and green-certified canvas coatings, antibacterial sealants, and polychloroprene glues for insulation systems.

name: Air Outlets & Accessories
description: Grilles, diffusers, sand trap louvers, jet nozzles, and linear slot terminals for optimized air distribution.
